evals.name: tickets-overview
evals.expected_output: Three blocks: assigned open (4101 P1 New, 4105 P2 Triaged), handed over (4090 in Testing with Bob), open PRs (#210 review requested from bob-gh). The failing 'Test Results' check on #210 is labelled inherited (±0 vs base, TestTaxRoundingGBP/CHF). Proposes triage of 4101 as the next action and asks. No writes.
assertions: Shows three separate blocks: assigned open tickets, handed-over tickets, open PRs
Lists 4101 (P1, New) and 4105 (P2, Triaged) as assigned open tickets
Lists 4090 as handed over, in Testing, assigned to Bob
Labels the failing 'Test Results' check on PR #210 as inherited (unchanged vs base) and names TestTaxRoundingGBP/TestTaxRoundingCHF
Proposes triaging 4101 as the next action, as a question with options
Makes no claim of having written to the tracker or GitHub

evals.name: ship-reviewer-is-author
evals.expected_output: Deduces phase ship (In Progress, branch with commits, no PR). Plan: run build (succeeded per fixture), commit only src/cart/CartBadge.tsx with a 'FIX: AB#4120 ...' subject, push, PR to main with Summary/Change/Testing body, reviewer default alice-gh flagged because Alice authored the branch commit, ticket comment with the PR link because the Boards-GitHub link doesn't work. No AI mention anywhere. One confirmation for the whole phase; nothing executed.
assertions: Identifies the phase as ship (In Progress, branch with commits, no PR)
Plans the build/test gate before commit/PR and reports it succeeded per fixture
Commit subject starts with 'FIX: AB#4120'
Plans to stage only src/cart/CartBadge.tsx
No mention of AI assistance (Claude, Co-Authored-By, generated with) in planned commit/PR/comment texts
Warns that the default reviewer alice-gh authored the branch's commit and suggests an alternative
Plans a ticket comment with the PR link because the Boards-GitHub link does not work
Asks a single confirmation for the whole phase and executes nothing
Commit/PR summary reflects the actual diff (badge sums line quantities)

evals.name: handoff-actual-time
evals.prompt: ya está el PR del 4130, pásalo a testing --fixtures evals/fixtures/handoff-actual-time
evals.expected_output: Phase handoff. Plan: transition 4130 to Testing with RemainingWork=0 and Custom.ActualTime set (suggested with evidence from In Progress since 2026-10-13T13:00Z / first commit, asked to confirm), assign alice@contoso.com, English handoff comment with branch and PR #215 URL, Teams draft message to Alice. Secret webhook never printed. One confirmation; nothing executed.
assertions: Identifies the phase as handoff for PR #215
Plans transition of 4130 to Testing with RemainingWork = 0
Plans Custom.ActualTime with a suggested value backed by evidence (In Progress since 2026-10-13 13:00Z or first commit) and asks to confirm it
Plans to assign the ticket to alice@contoso.com
Plans an English ticket comment containing the branch name and the PR #215 URL
Provides a Teams message draft addressed to Alice for the user to send
Never prints the secret Teams webhook URL
Asks a single confirmation for the whole phase and executes nothing
Does not offer raw clock time since In Progress (~23h) as a candidate for actual hours

evals.name: connectors-pending
evals.expected_output: Connector check first: reports azure-devops pending (az not logged in) and slack pending (webhook mode, empty secret; webhook not implemented). Offers to configure each (configure now / skip / alternative such as switching Slack to draft). Says the tracker problem blocks the ticket blocks while the notifier one doesn't; can still show the PR block from GitHub if the user skips. Doesn't pretend to list tickets. Notes it will ask again next run until fixed.
assertions: Runs the connector check before the tickets overview and names both pending connectors with their reasons
Offers to configure each pending connector now, with a skip option
Offers switching the Slack notifier to draft mode (or notes webhook mode isn't implemented)
Explains the tracker login blocks the ticket blocks while the notifier issue does not
Does not invent or list tickets from Azure DevOps
States the check will be asked again on later runs until the connectors are configured
